gitConfiguration.lfs.customtransfer.r2-bare-cedar-fog.arg: <absolute path to @red-cup-engineering/cloudflare-r2-services-section's scripts/git-lfs-r2-transfer-agent.mjs> --config=<this law's binding path, absolute>

rule: asset bytes are carried by the bucket bare-cedar-fog-git-lfs and addressed by their git-lfs object id; the monorepo carries pointers and all text. Because the agent is standalone, git-lfs contacts no LFS API server, so GitHub carries no asset bytes and meters no asset transfer. Objects are stored uncompressed, so a bucket object's SHA-256 equals its object id and any S3 client can verify custody without git-lfs.
credentialRule: key material lives only in the repository .env, is read at invocation, and is passed to the agent through the environment rather than argv so it does not appear in a process listing; the access key is scoped to this one bucket and cannot enumerate the account.
supersededInterface: the default GitHub LFS endpoint remains configured for lfs.<url>.access but carries nothing while standalonetransferagent is set; it is retained as rollback only.
unmigratedHistory: binaries committed before this law stay as raw git blobs, because the working repository is a blobless partial clone and rewriting history would require refetching the whole blob history from the origin. Converting them is deferred, not refused.
leaderJudgment: whether to de-partialize the clone and run git lfs migrate over existing history
